name: Construction Process
css: .tb-arch-construction-process{padding:clamp(42px,7vw,88px);background:var(--tb-color-secondary);color:var(--tb-color-surface)}.tb-arch-construction-process__head{max-width:800px;margin-bottom:36px}.tb-arch-construction-process__kicker{font-size:12px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--tb-color-accent)}.tb-arch-construction-process__title{font-size:clamp(38px,5vw,64px);line-height:1;margin:12px 0;color:var(--tb-color-surface)}.tb-arch-construction-process__steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));border-top:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--tb-color-surface) 30%,transparent)}.tb-arch-construction-process__step{padding:24px 22px;border-right:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--tb-color-surface) 22%,transparent)}.tb-arch-construction-process__number{display:block;color:var(--tb-color-accent);font-weight:900;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:38px}.tb-arch-construction-process__step-title{font-size:21px;margin:0 0 9px;color:var(--tb-color-surface)}.tb-arch-construction-process__step-text{margin:0;line-height:1.65;color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--tb-color-surface) 72%,transparent)}@media(max-width:850px){.tb-arch-construction-process__steps{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}@media(max-width:520px){.tb-arch-construction-process__steps{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
